agency.name: City of Vacaville Director of Finance

authority.citation: Vacaville Municipal Code ch. 3.06 (Community Services and Facilities Tax), §3.06.080 (Ord. 1843, 2012)

name: Community Services and Facilities Tax
notes: A general excise tax for the privilege of using city services. Section 3.06.080 states the levy 'at not to exceed' the amounts below, so they are ceilings in the ordinance, not a resolution of the amount billed this year. On an occupied single-family home the tax is collected with the city water and sewer bill, and neither service is cut off for nonpayment of the tax. On a business it is collected with the business license tax or by direct bill. On a short hotel stay it is collected with the transient occupancy tax. The chapter says the tax runs for a maximum of 25 years from the day after the Measure I excise tax approved on November 8, 1988 expires; that expiration date is not in the sections opened here. Section 3.06.050 says the proceeds are paid into the general fund. No collections or spending document for a named year was opened.

rates.applies_to: not to exceed, per occupied single-family residential unit per year, other than a transient stay
not to exceed, per apartment or mobile-home-park rental unit per year, for a stay longer than 30 days
not to exceed, per year, a business with one employee that is subject to the city business license tax
not to exceed, per year, a business with 2 to 5 employees
not to exceed, per year, a business with 6 to 12 employees
not to exceed, per year, a business with 13 to 25 employees
not to exceed, per year, a business with 26 to 50 employees
not to exceed, per year, a business with 51 to 100 employees
not to exceed, per year, a business with more than 100 employees
not to exceed, rent for a hotel stay of 30 days or fewer
